params.q: What is the current PPF interest rate in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the current PPF interest rate in India?

response.markdown:
The current PPF interest rate in India is **7.1% per annum**, unchanged since April 2020. [0] [1] The Ministry of Finance has kept it at 7.1% for the October–December 2026 quarter as well (announced 5 October 2026). Interest is calculated monthly on the lowest balance between the 5th and the last day of each month, compounded annually, and credited on 31 March each year. [2]
